derived/source/.github/workflows/cloud-e.text:
name: Provisional slave load-only trial with original MOS geometry
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      execute:
        description: Run full provisional electrical trial after source controls
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: cdr-slave-load-only-trial-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: '1'
jobs:
  source-controls:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /scripts/cdr-wire-shortcuts-loaded-pins.json
      - name: Materialize exact loaded source closure
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import json,subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          m='scripts/cdr-wire-shortcuts-loaded-pins.json'
          names=sorted(set(json.loads(Path(m).read_bytes())['files'])|{m})
          assert all(not n.startswith('/')and '..'not in Path(n).parts and not any(c in n for c in '*?[!\\\n\r')for n in names)
          subprocess.run(['git','sparse-checkout','set','--no-cone','--stdin'],input=''.join('/'+n+'\n'for n in names),text=True,check=True)
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir numpy==2.3.3
      - name: Verify unchanged complete numerical methods and current input refusals
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python3 -B scripts/cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded.py --controls 2>&1 | tee wire-loaded-controls.log
      - name: Preserve complete source-control results
        if: always()
        run: python3 -B scripts/cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded.py --derived-controls
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: wire-loaded-controls-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            wire-loaded-controls-derived
            wire-loaded-controls.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  loaded-wave:
    if: ${{ inputs.execute }}
    needs: source-controls
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /scripts/cdr-wire-shortcuts-loaded-pins.json
      - name: Materialize exact loaded source closure
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import json,subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          m='scripts/cdr-wire-shortcuts-loaded-pins.json'
          names=sorted(set(json.loads(Path(m).read_bytes())['files'])|{m})
          assert all(not n.startswith('/')and '..'not in Path(n).parts and not any(c in n for c in '*?[!\\\n\r')for n in names)
          subprocess.run(['git','sparse-checkout','set','--no-cone','--stdin'],input=''.join('/'+n+'\n'for n in names),text=True,check=True)
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Original frozen native-engine dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tcl8.6 libsndfile1 libsamplerate0 libreadline8t64 libxaw7 libxt6 libxft2 libfontconfig1
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir numpy==2.3.3
      - name: Require independently reserved current-source release
        id: reserve
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import sys
          sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
          import cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded as host
          host.gate()
          host.release_gate(wait=True)
          PY
      - name: Authenticate parent RC then simulate explicit eight-resistor load-only parameter trial
        id: native
        run: python3 -B scripts/cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded.py --simulate
      - name: Permanently preserve complete success or failure and native waves
        if: always() && steps.reserve.outcome == 'success'
        run: python3 -B scripts/cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded.py --publish
      - name: Select derived text without native payload
        if: always()
        run: python3 -B scripts/cloud_cdr_wire_shortcuts_loaded.py --derived
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: wire-loaded-derived-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: wire-loaded-derived
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: wire-loaded-native-fallback-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: cloud-wire-shortcuts-loaded
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90
